title: Auditing Meta and TikTok Research API Data Access under Article 40(12) of the Digital Services Act
author_or_org: Luka Bekavac & Simon Mayer (University of St. Gallen)
abstract_or_snippet: Posted 2025-06-05. Quantified gaps: TikTok Research API surfaces only ~75% of user-visible posts and 17% of visible metadata parameters; Instagram ~50% of posts and 42% of metadata; ephemeral/live content 0% accessible by design; 17.7-23.3% of posts vanish (deleted) within weeks of the audit window. Conclusion: DSA-mandated data access 'risks becoming procedurally satisfied but substantively weakened.'
